items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: You said Degard on drums... And Smitty's on piano. And myself. And yourself.

ctx.x: My two men are, what I was saying before, Paul Bourne and Bigard. Those are your standard men. In other words, they play something you know what they're playing.
You must have always liked New Collington's band. Oh yeah, yes. I guess.
